title: Set Total Capital display value to 327

requirements.text: Update the value shown in the public Home page "Overall Performance" section’s "Total Capital" tile (XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[4]/div[2]/div[1]) so it displays 327 (rendered with the existing currency formatting).
acceptanceCriteria: When visiting the Home page, the "Total Capital" tile renders as "$327.00" (or equivalent existing currency formatting for 327).
No other tiles or text in the "Overall Performance" section are changed.

constraints: Apply the change only to the selected element identified by XPath: /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[4]/div[2]/div[1].
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the Home page layout or change any other metrics/tiles.
Do not add new metrics fields or new UI controls.
